The Router underestimated the severity of the 'texture anomaly' by treating it as minor background noise; combined with the classifier failure, it suggests the image may be a 'hallucination' that resembles a chiton superficially but lacks the fine-grained feature distribution expected by the model. I am upgrading the artifact severity slightly due to the classifier confusion, interpreting the 'smearing' as a symptom of generative uncertainty.
